[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "A minimal HTTP/1.1 in-memory key-value server"
publish = false

[dependencies]

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/kvhttp app
